column1: # GLSL programs Darkest Dungeon compiles while it boots and plays its opening route, from two Mac host runs (DM_GL_CAPTURE):
#   v0      (1.0.0, modules 0d07c246…): 34 stages — the boot and prologue route the 1.0.0 App was made from;
#   v393216 (1.3.0, modules ff2bf225…): 37 stages — same route on the update, recorded in docs/research/darkest-dungeon-1.3.0-host-run.md.
# <key>.vert / <key>.frag, key = sha256(GLSL)[:16]. They are the same shaders the RomFS files and main's embedded strings give gl_shaders.py,
# so this table is evidence of what the game actually asks for, not a second source of shaders: it lists the keys each route looked up.
# The union is what shader_versions (v0 v393216) makes the library hold: 38 stages, the two routes sharing 33. 1.3.0 changes character.glsl's
# fragment section (cd007d35ba9501d5, v0 only -> 0605d19f3c7905fd), drops nothing else and adds character_stealth (033dd9a2d57447ba) plus
# 0254334078bfa6b2 and 99acd6af258ba2c4. tools/nxrom/gl_library.py checks both the table and the Metal functions the library really holds.
